_comment: This file is a top-level script with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It reads 64 chunked JSONL files (gen.chunk.00.jsonl through gen.chunk.63.jsonl) from gen_data/, merges them into a single list, and appends the combined data to gen_data/all_gen.jsonl. No argparse or CLI interface is present. Per the rules, no tool-use examples are included since there is no callable code.
run_merge_gen_data: run the python script to merge 64 chunked JSONL files into a single all_gen.jsonl output file
review_merge_gen_data: review the python script that merges chunked JSONL data files into one combined output file
refactor_merge_gen_data: refactor the merge script to use argparse for configurable chunk count and input output paths
summarize_merge_gen_data: summarize the python script that concatenates 64 gen.chunk JSONL files into all_gen.jsonl
test_merge_gen_data: test the merge script to verify all 64 JSONL chunks are correctly combined into the output file
